remesh.algorithm: Botsch-Kobbelt 2004: split > 4/3 L, collapse < 4/5 L, flip toward valence 6 (4 on boundary), tangential relaxation, project
remesh.derivation: Jung (plane): a triangle with all edges <= l lies in a disc of radius l/sqrt(3); with its vertices on the sphere it is within R - sqrt(R^2 - l^2/3) of it

taubin.relation: kPB = 1/lambda + 1/mu (Taubin 1995 eq. 9); f(k) = (1 - lambda k)(1 - mu k)
taubin.paperValues: kPB = 0.1 and lambda = 0.6307 (figures 3, 4); kPB from 0.01 to 0.1 recommended
